dataCheck.note: Commit 3034cbd (13 Nov 2026 23:49, marked [testflight]) added 45 independent butchers. The app now shows 151 places and the Meat filter returns 86. The videos and the App Store screenshots they use were made from the earlier 106-place build.

blockers: All three videos and their Instagram captions use counts from the 106-place build (106 places, 41 with meat, about 40, nearly 30). The current build shows 151 places and Meat returns 86 (73 with weekend hours). Videos 01 and 02 show 'Tap Filters, pick Meat: 106 -> 41 places', which the app no longer does. Rule 1.

45 of the 86 Meat results are now butcher shops, which are retailers, not producers. 'Ask the farmer the rest' (01) and 'Real meat. Real farmers.' (02), shown straight after the Meat filter, can imply the Meat results are all farmers. docs/APP_STORE.md says the copy must not say where a butcher's meat comes from. Rules 1 and 2.
Videos 02 and 03 show the Dynamic Island cut-out from the screenshots inside the CSS phone, which makes it read as an iPhone (video 01 paints it over). Rule 5, possible risk.
